Travel and hospitality / Accommodation

GEO promotion for hotels and country resorts

Travellers look for a particular experience: a family weekend, a winter pool, a quiet retreat or pet-friendly accommodation. I measure which properties AI recommends for those needs and whether promised facilities are supported.

  • Guest intents by trip type, season and location without brand terms
  • Verification of accommodation classification, facilities and booking conditions
  • Accurate hotel information and comparable BMR checks

Personally led by Alexey Yakovlev, GEO/AEO consultant

Selection barriers

Why attractive hotel photography is not sufficient

Services and booking terms can vary by building, room type and arrival date. AI may repeat outdated star categories or imply a facility is included when it is not.

01

Classification details are out of date

A hotel's claimed category must match the applicable current status. Russian accommodation classification rules and registry information should be checked for the individual property.

02

Packages and amenities are confused

Full board, swimming pool use, spa access and children's programmes may depend on the selected room, package or season. Clear availability and charges matter.

03

Location is presented too generally

Station access, transfers, beaches, winter routes and outdoor activities change with season and transport conditions. A map pin does not establish practical access.

Verifiable facts

Evidence that supports an accommodation recommendation

I verify the property identity, current booking terms and actual amenities. Russian classification rules governing accommodation types and categories help separate official status from marketing language.

  • Property and classification: accommodation type, registry details and current category where applicable
  • Booking: room capacities, family and pet policies, meals, cancellations and date-dependent rates
  • Amenities: real spa and pool opening, parking, accessibility, transport and seasonal restrictions

GAEO's experience with tour operator GEO informs travel-intent research, but is not presented as a completed hotel GEO campaign.

Scope of work

How I structure GEO for a hotel

Establish which property types AI suggests to each guest group, verify what the hotel offers and develop consistently sourced content.

  1. 01

    Baseline by guest need

    Measure stable non-brand queries for families, couples, spa trips, business stays and seasonal activities.

  2. 02

    Check current services

    Review classification, room types, package descriptions and date-dependent booking conditions.

  3. 03

    Improve hotel pages and profiles

    Specify room and package pages, location advice, booking FAQs and consistent external sources.

  4. 04

    Repeat comparable checks

    Compare the same AI prompts and inspect citations, inaccurate amenity claims and BMR.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Can a hotel feature in AI recommendations without large booking platforms?+

Potentially yes, through accurate first-party content and verifiable public sources. Inclusion still depends on the question, the source coverage and the AI service.

How should hotel stars and classification be described?+

Refer to the current applicable property classification and verified registry information. Do not present an outdated or desired rating as official.

Can guest reviews be used?+

Use real attributable reviews with relevant dates, and do not invent scores or mix experiences from unrelated properties.

How should seasonal facilities be handled?+

Publish actual operating periods, opening times, inclusions and fees. The availability of pools, transfers, dining and spa treatments may differ by package.

What does resort GEO promotion cost?+

GAEO's published audit and monthly plans apply. Scope depends on properties, languages, seasons and guest-intent segments.
